Resolution of billing/ charging complaints within four weeks This parameter is intended to facilitate resolution of billing or charging complaints in a timely manner. The billing or charging related complaints shall include all types of complaints received from postpaid or pre-paid subscribers which involves any monetary aspect or validity period.
